name: Green Meadow Waldorf Summer Programs
description_short: Outdoor summer programs led by Waldorf teachers on Green Meadow's 11 acres of farm, forest and streams in Chestnut Ridge, for ages 3 to 12. Marigolds (3 to 5) explore the forest and garden, Summer Farmers (5 to 10) care for the farm animals and gardens, and Art & Adventure (8 to 12) carve wood, hike and swim at the pond.

sessions.name: Marigolds, ages 3 to 5 (Mon to Thu 8:30 to 2:45)
Art & Adventure, ages 8 to 12 (Mon to Thu 8:45 to 3)

notes: 2026: $650 a week for each program. Marigolds must be toilet trained. When checked, all 2026 weeks of Summer Farmers and Art & Adventure and the last two Marigolds weeks were full. Separate registration links for GMWS and non GMWS families; no different rate is posted.
